name: Expeditious Excavation

area.text: cube of dirt 5 feet across or smaller

outcomes.success: The creature is unaffected and can choose to either descend the pit without damage or move to the nearest available space of its choice.
outcomes.failure: The creature falls prone in the nearest available space of its choice, or falls into the pit if it prefers.
outcomes.criticalFailure: The creature falls into the pit excavated by the spell and lands prone, taking falling damage as normal.

heightening.text: The spell can excavate an additional 5-foot cube of earth. If you excavate all four 5-foot cubes beneath a Large creature, it must attempt a Reflex save or Acrobatics check, as above.

entries: You remove loose dirt, dust, gravel, sand, and the like (though not solid stone) up to the size of a 5-foot cube. Any Medium or smaller creature standing atop the earth when the spell is cast must attempt a Reflex save or Acrobatics check.
